TROVELA Regional Director, DILG Region VII Sudlon, Lahug, Cebu City Dear RD Trovela: This has reference to your first indorsement dated 5 September 2022 requesting for this Department's comments and guidance on the Executive Orders issued by Hon. Felipe Antonio B. Remollo, Mayor of Dumaguete City, deputizing Sangguniang Bayan Members as deputy to the Mayor for various concerns. At the outset, Section 458 of R.A. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC) specifically provides for the powers, duties and functions of the Sanggunian Panlungsod, which are legislative in nature. Nowhere in the said Code that allows the deputization of a Sanggunian Bayan Member as a deputy to the Mayor, which may be considered as an executive function. A Sangguniang Bayan Member cannot simultaneously perform the functions and duties in both the offices of the Mayor and the Sangguniang Bayan since it would intermingle two separate powers, i.e., executive and legislative, which has been delineated and vested by law to two separate offices, to provide a system of checks and balances thereby ensuring a better delivery of public services. 1 Furthermore, Section 94 of the LGC provides: "Section 94. Appointment of Elective and Appointive Local Officials; Candidates Who Lost in an Election. - (a) No elective or appointive local official shall be eligible for appointment or desiqnation in any capacity to any public office or position durinq his tenure. Unless otherwise allowed by law or by the primary functions of his position, no elective or appointive local official shall hold any other office or employment in the government or any subdivision, agency or instrumentality thereof, including government-owned or controlled corporations or their subsidiaries." (Emphasis ours) Hence, the deputization of Sangguniang Bayan Member as Deputy to the Mayor on various concerns would be a usurpation that violates the separation of powers principle that underlies our Constitution, and Section 94 of the LGC. 1 DILG Legal Opinion No. 23, S. 2012, March 07, 2012 "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

The opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated and our appreciation of the same. Further, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion issued by more competent authorities and/or the courts. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AU ITY OF THE SECRETARY. VICTOR R. LLAMAS Unders etary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLAJVRLJLLLS-LRALLD/rrao
